doc.title: SupKonQuest — Noa Tournoy
doc.desc: SupKonQuest: an isometric real-time strategy game for 2 to 8 players online. Pathfinding, three-tier AI, server deployed on a Raspberry Pi. C++, Unreal Engine, Docker.
lede: A modernised take on Risk, played in real time: an isometric 2D and 3D strategy game for two to eight players, online.
sujet.1: Risk is played in turns; SupKonQuest removes the waiting. Resources accrue continuously, units move while the opponent is still deciding, and the isometric map has to stay readable with eight simultaneous players.
sujet.2: That change of regime moves the whole problem: resource management becomes a flow to balance, and unit micro-management requires the machine to find its own way across constrained ground.
f1.p: Pathfinding algorithms on the isometric grid: units route around terrain and occupied cells without being guided square by square.
f2.p: An AI in three difficulty tiers, from the player still learning the rules to the one looking for a real game. Writing three tiers forces you to separate what belongs to strategy from what belongs to precision of execution.
f3.p: A server architecture deployed on a Raspberry Pi, containerised with Docker. A healthy constraint: on a machine that size, a chatty protocol or a greedy loop shows up immediately.
colo.face: Set in Roboto Flex, opsz, wght, wdth and GRAD axes, subset to Latin, 235 KB. Scrolling holds the slider.
colo.hand: Written by hand: no dependencies, no third-party requests, no tracker. The text reads without JavaScript.
